messages:
priya: Heads up — CI on main turned red right after the lockfile merge. failing tests in network/http/test_http_integration, looks like SSL handshake errors.
ci-bot: Build #4523 failed — pytest -k test_http_integration (linux, py3.10)
ariane: ugh. which test exactly? pinging @matt for eyes.
matt: seen it, repro in the logs: TLS alert during requests session init.
priya: copied the failing snippet:
```
requests.exceptions.SSLError: [SSL: TLSV1_ALERT_PROTOCOL_VERSION] tlsv1 alert protocol version (_ssl.c:1123)
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```
ken: did the lock bump something like urllib3/cryptography/certifi? Those usually cause this.
priya: checking the merged lock diff now — looks like urllib3 went from 1.26.7 -> 2.0.1 (pulled in via httpx), certifi bumped too.
matt: urllib3 2.x has some API/ssl surface changes and can trigger different TLS stacks. possible transitive pin problem.
ariane: can we bisect the lockfile merge to find the exact commit that introduced the bump? I don't want to revert blindly.
priya: started a quick bisect locally: `git checkout main && git bisect start --replay` then iterating on lockfile-only commits. first bad commit looks like the merge that updated poetry.lock from the dep sync PR.
ken: if it's the merge commit, it probably came from an automated regen. we should confirm the upstream transitive dependency that caused the version jump.
matt: short term: revert the lockfile change in main so CI is green, open an emergency PR that pins urllib3 back until we have a proper upgrade plan.
priya: opened PR #4152 to revert the lockfile merge and pinned urllib3 to 1.26.16 in pyproject extras for test env — CI rerun queued. :thumbsup:
devx-bot: Rerun triggered for PR #4152 by @ariane — job queued.
ariane: when this is in, we should add a tiny smoke test in CI that establishes an https connection to a public TLS endpoint (or loopback with modern TLS) so future bumps fail fast.
ken: agree. also add a note to the lockfile merge checklist: run integration TLS smoke before merging transitive bumps.
priya: will add the checklist item and file a short postmortem in eng-infra channel once the revert is in.
matt: thanks all. if someone oncall wants to follow up with a full bisect log, drop it here and we can trace the transitive chain (httpx -> urllib3 upgrade path).
priya: will paste the bisect output and the lock diff in this thread shortly.
ariane: ETA ~15m for the revert to land and CI to green.
priya: confirmed — revert merged, CI passing on PR run, marking this as triaged.
matt: awesome — follow-up: create an issue to audit automation that regens lockfiles to avoid surprise major bumps.
priya: filed ISSUE-789 in eng-infra repo and linked PR. thanks everyone.
